Hostile case H-04 (CRLF in pnpm-workspace.yaml and in an app package.json): each commit changes 2 files; the results are [www-reading-advantage] and [storytime]; killed by S1 and S2. CRLF does not turn the workspace file into a global change.
Vacuity proof: S1 (prints [] exit 0) and S2 (prints all 10 ids exit 0) each fail all four hostile cases (4 failed of 4). No hostile case passes for every script.

Harness measurement that produced N1: changedFileCount on the 1.2 MB H-03 listing returned 8626 paths, because the helper git() has no maxBuffer. The real script read all 10000 paths and returned [storytime] once the count used a 1 GB reader.
